correctness.rationale: For all balanced length-four words, disjoint endpoint sets and the exact candidate formula reduce the possibilities to size-20 relevant endpoint types. Two forbidden self-borders exclude 1x3 and 3x1; two self-borders and three disjoint incompatible pairs exclude mixed 2x2; uniform endpoints reduce to a complete directed bipartite rectangle of at most four alternating words. All equality cases require a 2+2 split of four blocks and all four edges, yielding exactly twelve codes and orbit sizes 4,8. Full standalone verify.py independently exhausts all 72 unbordered balanced words as a clique graph and checks the result.

originality.rationale: The small-parameter maximum size 20 is explicitly prior-covered by the 2024/2025 polarity-balanced non-overlapping paper. The accepted final claim is instead the complete enumeration of all twelve equality cases, exact two-block construction and two orbit sizes 4 and 8. Closest primary full texts were inspected at their relevant results; no matching extremizer classification found. A possible unindexed equivalent classification remains a residual originality risk.
residual_risks: The constrained polarity-balanced optimum 20 is known; the interpretation of the present theorem must remain strictly the new equality classification.

value.rationale: This is a natural first nonbinary small DNA synchronization model with exact physically meaningful GC balance. Complete enumeration and the two inequivalent maximizing block geometries characterize actual design diversity, not just re-proving the existing numeric limit. The endpoint exclusion argument and block-grid factorization expose which optimizers can be used or ruled out when adding extra code-design constraints. Finite parameter scope is explicit and does not claim larger implications.
